Pistachio Dream
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, February 13, 2010 - 3:21am

Ingredients




8 ounces Cool Whip , thawed
1 can (20 oz) crushed pineapple, (with juice)
1 box (3 oz) pistachio instant pudding (dry), (don't pre
2 ounces Walnuts, chopped

Preparation

1 Mix all ingredients together. Put in an attractive clear bowl. Refridgerate several hours to blend flavors.Serves approx. 12-15 people
